notes: Successfully fetched official Verra VCS Validation/Verification Bodies list. Extracted 60 unique entities across multiple programs: VCS, CCBS, SD VISta, and Plastic. Status includes 4 suspended bodies (effective Mar 25, 2025). Note: Some entities appear as approval-pending in certain programs while active in others; consolidated status reflects their most active status. Program scopes included in 'extra' field to indicate multi-program accreditation.

Successfully retrieved complete list from official UNFCCC CDM Designated Operational Entities registry. 23 active entities and 40 withdrawn/expired entities extracted. No individual entity websites provided on registry page. Country information inferred from entity names and descriptions where not explicitly stated on page. Validation and verification scopes (numbered 1-16 representing different CDM project types) included in extra field for active entities. Registry page is single-page listing; no sub-pages required.

Gold Standard VVB registry exists at globalgoals.goldstandard.org but could not be retrieved. WebFetch failed with socket errors on both primary URLs (verification-validation-bodies/ and all-validation-and-verification-bodies/). Bash curl also returned empty. The site appears to use client-side rendering or request-blocking. Web searches confirm a searchable table with VVB names, countries, scopes, and status exists and is continuously updated, but direct extraction was not achievable. Contact vvb@goldstandard.org for current list or use browser-based access to globalgoals.goldstandard.org.

Successfully retrieved CARB MRR accredited verification bodies list from https://ww2.arb.ca.gov/mrr-vb. The page contains an HTML table with 28 active/pending verification bodies. Each entry includes Executive Order number, organization name, address, contact person, phone, email, website, accreditation year, and valid-through date. All entities are located in the USA. Status includes: H-series Executive Orders (active accreditations), pending accreditations, and reaccreditations. The list was last updated as of the page access date (July 17, 2026).

The CARB LCFS accredited verification bodies registry exists at https://ww2.arb.ca.gov/lcfs-verification, which indicates that a list of accredited verification bodies is maintained in an Excel file (List of LCFS Verification Bodies as of 2026_04_23.xlsx, updated 5/1/2026). However, the server returns HTTP 403 Forbidden errors for both WebFetch attempts and direct file downloads, likely due to Cloudflare or similar server-side protection. The page content was partially accessible via curl but did not contain an embedded HTML list of verification bodies—only references to the downloadable Excel file and PDFs that are similarly blocked. To access the current list, users should contact CARB directly at lcfsverify@arb.ca.gov or use a browser to download the file from the official page.

Successfully retrieved ACR Approved Validation/Verification Bodies list (Version 2.9, dated 2026-07-14). Document is an official PDF from ACR containing 13 approved VVBs with full contact information. All listed entities have Verification and Validation status. Some entities noted as covering multiple sectoral scopes. Document indicates ANAB accreditation requirement per ISO 14065. Two entities (EPIC Sustainability and OmnexFuturepast) listed with Indian addresses despite appearing to have US affiliations - address data extracted as shown in document.

Successfully retrieved 18 accredited verification bodies from the Climate Action Reserve website. All entities shown are currently recognized and qualified as verification bodies. Website URLs included where provided; no status information was displayed on the registry page. Sectors/scopes indicate the project types each verifier is qualified to validate.

Official ANAB registry at anab.ansi.org and anabpd.ansi.org is protected by Cloudflare and returned HTTP 403 Forbidden via WebFetch and curl. The search.anab.org directory does not list GHG bodies. Retrieved 18 ANAB-accredited bodies from Climate Action Reserve's publicly listed verification bodies, all of which are officially recognized as ANAB ISO 14065 accredited. This represents CAR's current verified list only, not the complete ANAB registry. For the complete ANAB registry, direct access to the protected directory is required via JavaScript-enabled browser or authentication.

Successfully retrieved 19 unique UKAS accredited Validation/Verification Bodies from a 3-page directory listing. All entities shown are active and accredited for validation and verification under UKAS framework. The directory is browsable at the category-filtered URL (type=283 for Validation/Verification Bodies). Most bodies are based in the UK with representation from Germany (4), Greece (2), France (1), Italy (1), South Korea (1), and Japan (1). No pagination limit was reached; three pages returned complete results with some duplicate listings across pages which were deduplicated in final output."

DAkkS maintains an official accredited bodies database for verification and validation bodies (VVBs) accredited under DIN EN ISO/IEC 17029 for EU ETS, but the registry is accessible only as an interactive search tool at https://www.dakks.de/en/accredited-bodies-search.html — not as a static list, PDF export, or machine-readable data file. Users must query the database with filters (conformity assessment activity, geographic location, certificate status) to retrieve specific entities. No public archive, bulk export, or pre-compiled list of all accredited DAkkS verification bodies for EU ETS could be located via web search or official DAkkS pages. The interactive database is the authoritative source but not fetchable as static content.

Successfully retrieved 6 accredited EU ETS verification bodies from Cofrac's official search results. All entities are France-based. Accreditation status shown as active for all listed bodies. Websites not provided in source data. Scope information indicates activity groups (1a-1c, 2-9, 12, 98) and sectors (maritime, aviation) covered by each verifier. The PDF database (Base_organismes_verificateurs_accredites_SEQE-UE_-_Database_accredited_verification_bodies_EU-ETS-22.04.2026.pdf) dated 22.04.2026 was referenced but returned 403 Forbidden; data extracted from HTML search results page instead.

Accredia registry located and accessible, but requires interactive JavaScript-based search interface to retrieve verifier data. The database search page at https://services.accredia.it/ppsearch/accredia_orgmask.jsp?ID_LINK=1733&area=310 allows filtering by ISO 14065, EU ETS, and sector criteria. Examples of Italian EU ETS verifiers identified: IGQ, RINA, Normec Verifavia. Accredia recently reorganized accreditations (effective 2025) with new accreditation numbering system. For complete current list, direct database interaction or contact with Accredia (info@accredia.it, +39 06 8440991) required.

ENAC maintains an interactive search database at https://www.enac.es/entidades-acreditadas/buscador-de-acreditados for accredited bodies, but the tool is JavaScript-based and not accessible via WebFetch. The 5 entities listed were confirmed from official ENAC news announcements (February 2025 and 2026) regarding EU ETS 2 accreditations. These entities have expanded their accreditation scopes to include greenhouse gas emission trading verification under the EU ETS 2 framework. Website URLs for individual verifiers were not provided by ENAC in the public announcements. For a more comprehensive list or historical EU ETS 1 verifiers, direct access to ENAC's interactive search tool or contact with ENAC directly would be required. The list may not be exhaustive as the database is continuously updated.

Successfully retrieved official RvA EU ETS verifiers list from the Overzicht-EU-ETS.pdf document (version 30-09-2025). Three verification bodies are currently accredited by RvA for EU ETS verification activities. All entities listed are active verification bodies with current accreditation status. The PDF is the authoritative registry maintained by RvA, accessible through their Validation and Verification Bodies page at https://www.rva.nl/en/greenhouse-gas-verification-bodies/

Successfully retrieved list from KOBiZE (national EU ETS implementation agency for Poland). Extracted all 9 PCA-accredited verifiers from the Installations sector. Verified detailed information via individual PCA verifier pages (PL-VG-0015, PL-VG-0001). No verifiers from Aviation sector carry PCA accreditation in the current registry. The PCA website maintains individual verifier pages but no consolidated directory page; KOBiZE provides the authoritative consolidated listing. All entities are accredited by Polish Centre for Accreditation (PCA) and are active as of the registry publication date.

Successfully retrieved official ISCC certification bodies directory. 76 active certification/verification bodies extracted from structured table. All entities are accredited and active with no withdrawn or suspended status shown. Scope/scheme accreditation information includes: ISCC EU, ISCC PLUS, ISCC CORSIA, ISCC CORSIA PLUS, CFC (Circular Economy), and Canada CFR. Accrediting bodies noted in parentheses (UKAS, BLE, ANAB, etc.) represent national/regional accreditation authorities.

Successfully retrieved complete RSB certification bodies list. 6 active ISO 17065-accredited certification bodies currently authorized by RSB. All accreditations listed with their respective national accreditation bodies (ENAC for Spain, CNAS for China, COFRAC for France, ANAB for USA, ACCREDIA for Malaysia). One body (Trans) has scope limitation for EU RED scheme GHG verification pending ISO 14065 accreditation.

Partial list retrieved. The official GCC verifiers page (https://globalcarboncouncil.com/for-stakeholders/verifiers/) uses JavaScript/AJAX dynamic table loading, which prevents full static HTML extraction. The website returns HTTP 403 Forbidden on direct fetch attempts. The entities listed above were extracted from recent press announcements found via web search (2025-2026 announcements). The complete list is available on the GCC website but requires JavaScript execution to access. A complete enumeration of all current approved verifiers would require either: (1) browser automation to load and render the dynamic tables, or (2) direct access to the Ninja Tables AJAX endpoint used by the website.

The official ICAO CORSIA verification bodies registry is published only as image-based PDF documents that cannot be text-extracted. The primary source "Part I: List of Verification Bodies Accredited in States (Edition 14, Feb 2026)" reportedly contains 56 verification bodies from 34 States but is not accessible via text extraction. No public HTML or searchable database version exists. Verification bodies are accredited at the national level by each State's accreditation body per ISO 14065 and ISO/IEC 17011 standards. Access to the complete list requires downloading and manually reviewing the ICAO PDF or accessing the authenticated ICAO CCR portal at https://www.icao.int/CORSIA/CCR. Individual national accreditation bodies (e.g., Singapore's SAC, European Accreditation) maintain their own registries with state-specific verification bodies.

The Climate Registry maintains accredited verification bodies lists, but the official PDFs are not publicly accessible online. Only the Applicant VB list from March 2023 was retrievable; it contained one entry. The current accredited verification bodies list (referenced as April 2025 update) is not accessible via public web URLs and appears to require direct contact with TCR or authentication. ANAB's accreditation directory is also authentication-gated. Recommendation: Contact The Climate Registry at help@theclimateregistry.org for complete current list of accredited verification bodies."

Successfully retrieved and parsed the Excel register (as of 9 June 2026) containing 86 registered auditors representing 38 unique verification bodies. All entities are greenhouse and energy auditors accredited under Australia's National Greenhouse and Energy Reporting (NGER) scheme and related carbon credit schemes (ACCU, Safeguard, RET). Auditors are categorized as Category 1 (full qualifications) or Category 2 (partial qualifications with conditions). Registry includes individual auditor names, companies, locations by state, and specific audit permissions/restrictions. One entity (Deloitte Touche Tohmatsu) has operations in both Australia and India. Status field is empty as all listed auditors appear to be actively registered with no explicit suspension/withdrawal indicators shown in the spreadsheet.

Puro.earth does not maintain a publicly accessible list of approved third-party auditors (VVBs). Multiple searches of their website, registry, document library, and public governance documents yielded no centralized directory. While Puro.earth requires all VVBs to be accredited by International Accreditation Forum (IAF) members and compliant with ISO 14065/17029/17065/17020/14034, they manage VVB relationships internally and pay for auditors on behalf of suppliers. Individual VVBs (e.g., 350Solutions) appear in audit reports but no master list is published. Other carbon standards (e.g., Proba.earth) publish approved VVB directories; Puro.earth does not. Direct contact with Puro.earth required for current approved VVB list.

Isometric does not maintain a public comprehensive registry of approved VVBs. The Governance & Policies page displays 11 validation and verification partners with logos, presented as partners rather than as an official approved VVBs directory. Additional VVBs (SustainCERT, SGS) were identified through separate press announcements. The VVB Policy document exists but the actual approved list is not published as a structured registry. Isometric registry site (registry.isometric.com) contains protocol and standard documentation but no dedicated VVB directory page.

Successfully retrieved Plan Vivo's official list of approved Validation and Verification Bodies (VVBs). The registry page lists 12 approved VVBs for carbon and nature projects. No explicit country, status, or sector information was displayed on the listing page; only organization names and external website links were provided. All entities are approved to conduct validations and verifications for Plan Vivo certification.

Successfully retrieved 13 verification bodies from the official SocialCarbon VVBs page. 12 are active; 1 (EPIC Sustainability Services) has withdrawn but retains verification eligibility through April 30, 2026. Each entity's sectoral scope coverage is documented per Social Carbon Foundation's accreditation scheme.

Retrieved 10 accredited certification bodies from the EPD International official registry. The page shows pagination controls (pages 1, 2, 3) but URL parameters do not paginate — attempting page=2 and page=3 return identical results to page 1. The page displays "Show: 10 items" and indicates these are the approved accredited certification bodies authorized by EPD International AB to conduct EPD verification and process certification under ISO 14025. No direct website URLs or status (active/suspended/withdrawn) are shown on the listing; contact via EPD Portal required.

Successfully retrieved 24 active authorized VVBs from the official Cercarbono Validation & Verification Bodies page. All entities maintain current accreditation with recognized international bodies (IAF, DOE, ONAC, EMA, NABCB, GAB, ANAB). Scope information includes multiple sectors from Energy, Industry, Transport, Construction, Waste Management, and Land Use. Some VVBs noted as holding additional Circular Economy accreditation.

The BioCarbon Registry (biocarbonstandard.com) does not maintain a publicly accessible, searchable directory of approved Conformity Assessment Bodies (CABs) / VVBs. The official websites biocarbonregistry.com and app.biocarbonregistry.com both have expired SSL certificates. The validation and verification manual (BCR_validation-and-verification-manual.pdf) could not be parsed. Based on search results, only two verification bodies could be identified with any certainty: Applus+ Certification and re-carbon. The registry indicates that CABs must apply directly (admin@biocarbonstandard.com) but does not publish an approved bodies list. This is a partial list based on limited publicly available information."

Alberta does not maintain a publicly available registry of approved TIER verifiers. The TIER (Technology Innovation and Emissions Reduction) Regulation requires verification bodies to be accredited by International Accreditation Forum (IAF) members, but Alberta does not publish a directory of these entities. For approved verifier information, inquiries must be directed to Alberta Environment and Protected Areas at [email protected]. Main regulatory pages (TIER regulation, Alberta Emission Offset System) were checked and confirmed to contain no verifier lists.

Primary registry (japancredit.go.jp) returned HTTP 403 Forbidden and is inaccessible. Data extracted from secondary sources (RECCPEDIA, search results) that cite official J-Credit Scheme documentation dated June 2020 and August 2023. All listed agencies are required to be certified by ISO 14065. As of June 2020, official sources reference 7 qualified examining agencies total; only 6 are clearly named in accessible secondary sources. Current status and complete sector qualifications (EN, IN, AG, WA, FO) could not be verified due to inaccessibility of primary registry. This list is partial and may be outdated.

Successfully retrieved official K-ETS verification bodies list from South Korea's National Institute of Environmental Research (NIER). All 8 listed verification bodies are currently active with expiration dates through mid-2026. Designation numbers follow the pattern YYYY-N (e.g., 2011-6). Registry also maintains accreditation information for international aviation carbon verification but main K-ETS scope covers the 8 GHG verification bodies listed. Last updated 2025-2026 data.

First batch of CCER verification and validation bodies (VVBs) officially announced by CNCA (National Certification and Accreditation Administration) on June 11, 2024. These five institutions were approved to conduct verification and validation work for greenhouse gas voluntary emission reduction projects under the reinvigorated CCER scheme (relaunched January 2024 after 6-year suspension). No second or third batch announcements found as of July 2026. Individual websites and detailed accreditation documents not accessible through public sources fetched. Registry list maintained by CNAS at cnas.org.cn but database requires interactive access (not retrievable via WebFetch).

The Gold Standard VVB registry at globalgoals.goldstandard.org is a JavaScript-heavy SPA that blocks automated crawling via WebFetch, curl, and standard HTTP clients (socket closed errors, SSL failures). The official PDF list (Approved_VVBs_18June2021.pdf) is similarly inaccessible. The registry is continuously updated with new approvals (December 2024, February 2025 confirmed). To retrieve the complete list, direct browser access or contact with Gold Standard (vvb@goldstandard.org) is required. At least one approved firm identified: SustainCERT.

Unable to access the official CARB registry list directly. The CARB website (ww2.arb.ca.gov) returns 403 Forbidden errors via CloudFront blocking. Only entities confirmed through their own published websites, press releases, and third-party announcements are included. A complete authoritative list exists at the CARB LCFS Verification page but is not currently accessible. Contact lcfsverify@arb.ca.gov or visit https://ww2.arb.ca.gov/lcfs-verification directly via web browser for the official complete list. References indicate 23 total accredited verification bodies in the US as of 2019-2020, with approximately 10 based in California.

18 ANAB-accredited ISO 14065 verification bodies retrieved from Climate Action Reserve, a secondary registry that states it works with ANAB for accreditation. Official ANAB sources (anab.ansi.org, anabpd.ansi.org, search.anab.org) are blocked or do not expose ISO 14065 in searchable formats. RemoteAuditor directory and Wayback Machine access failed. The Climate Registry PDF list could not be parsed from binary format. Entities sourced from publicly listed verification body rosters maintained by GHG program administrators that partner with ANAB.

The official DAkkS registry for EU-ETS accredited verifiers in Germany exists at https://www.dakks.de/de/akkreditierte-stellen-suche.html but is JavaScript-only and not accessible via static retrieval. No downloadable PDF, Excel, or archived versions of the complete verifier list found. DEHSt (German Emissions Trading Authority) at https://www.dehst.de confirms DAkkS maintains the directory but provides no alternative static list. Individual verifiers can be found through their own websites (e.g., Weyer Cert GmbH with accreditation D-VS-22586-01-00) but no official registry pages were successfully fetched to build an authoritative entity list. Accreditation is specific by activity group (D-VS codes), not global. To access current list, users must visit DAkkS website directly and use interactive search database.

Partial list extracted from searchable Accredia database. The complete registry contains additional accredited verifiers that require direct interactive database access to retrieve. Accredia has accredited approximately 15 organizations for EU ETS/ISO 14065 verification. The dynamic nature of the Accredia search interface (https://services.accredia.it/ppsearch/) prevents complete automated extraction. Users must access the database directly and filter by accreditation scheme 'UNI EN ISO 14065:2022' or 'ISO/IEC 17029:2022' with ETS scope code 01c for the current complete list. Additional known accredited verifiers include: Certiquality S.r.l., DNV Italia S.r.l., ICMQ S.p.A., LLOYD'S Register Quality Assurance Italy S.p.A., KIWA CERMET Italia S.r.l., but these require verification via direct database access.</notes>
</invoke>

The official Global Carbon Council verifiers directory (globalcarboncouncil.com/for-stakeholders/verifiers/) is inaccessible via direct HTTP fetch (returns 403 Forbidden). The list above contains 10 verified GHG Verification Bodies (GVBs) extracted from publicly available sources including their official websites and GCC news announcements. According to search results, the GCC maintains a total of 18 approved verifiers, but the complete list is not publicly accessible through the verified sources I could fetch. Entities are primarily firms (medium-to-large organizations) rather than individual practitioners. Most verifiers are based in India (6), with others in Germany, Spain, and Turkey. All have documented approval/re-approval status through 2025-2027.

Data extracted from ICAO CORSIA Central Registry (CCR): Information and Data for Transparency, Part I - 13th Edition (December 2025). Official PDF contains 62 accredited verification bodies from 34 countries/states. All verification bodies are accredited for CORSIA emissions verification in accordance with ISO 14065:2013 and ISO/IEC 17011. Document URL verified and content extracted via text processing of official ICAO PDF.

12 ANAB-accredited verification bodies extracted from The Climate Registry's official August 2025 list. All entities are firms. Document notes that verification bodies apply for ANAB accreditation per ISO 14065 standard. All contact information (addresses, phone, email) verified from source PDF.

Retrieved 10 independent, accredited third-party Validation and Verification Bodies (VVBs) from Puro.earth's official partners page. All entities are listed as firms. Puro.earth manages and pays for these independent auditors on behalf of suppliers. VVBs must be accredited by a National Accreditation Body (NAB) that is a member of the International Accreditation Forum (IAF) and must comply with ISO 14065, ISO 17029, ISO 17065, ISO 17020 or ISO 14034 standards. Approved VVBs are listed on Puro.earth's website upon successful completion of their first audit.

BioCarbon Registry does not publish a publicly accessible official directory of approved VVBs/Conformity Assessment Bodies. The registry domains (biocarbonregistry.com and biocarbonstandard.com) have certificate/access issues. The Validation and Verification Manual and Standard Operating Procedures describe CAB requirements and approval processes but do not list approved entities. Only one entity (Applus+ Certification) found with verifiable public evidence of BioCarbon Registry approval. Official approval list maintained internally by Global CarbonTrace (registry operator); applicants must contact admin@biocarbonstandard.com for CAB approval application process."

The official J-Credit verification bodies registry at japancredit.go.jp/about/vvb/ returns HTTP 403 Forbidden to all bot requests, blocking automated access. WebFetch and Wayback Machine access both failed. Identified 3 confirmed J-Credit ISO 14065 verification bodies from accessible web pages, though the official source indicates there are 10 total bodies. The steering committee PDF listing all 10 bodies (japancredit.go.jp/steering_committee/data/haihu_01/03.pdf) is also blocked by the 403 restriction. Alternative sources confirm these organizations serve as J-Credit auditors/verifiers with ISO 14065 accreditation from JAB (Japan Accreditation Board).

SWEDAC accreditation register exists and is searchable at ackrediteringar.swedac.se/en. The register contains EU ETS verifiers and greenhouse gas validation/verification bodies accredited under ISO 14065:2021 and ISO 14064 standards. However, no static list, PDF, spreadsheet, or fetchable HTML page containing the complete registry of individual verifiers is publicly available. The verifier information is only accessible through the interactive search interface of SWEDAC's database. To obtain a complete list, users must either: (1) search the register directly at ackrediteringar.swedac.se/en, or (2) contact SWEDAC at registrator@swedac.se or +46-771-99-09-00. Contact for greenhouse gas verification matters: Elin Lagnemo (elin.lagnemo@swedac.se, Lead Assessor, Industrial Unit).

The official DANAK registry of EU ETS verifiers (https://published.danak.dk/searchregister.asp?nohead=y&sektorsel=%7BE2C6E7E4-4F3D-4947-81DA-D17A49891FFA%7D&lang=e) exists but uses dynamic/interactive search functionality that does not expose data through static web fetching. The registry displays 'Nothing Found' or fails to load verifier data in text format. No alternative downloadable list (PDF, Excel, etc.) of all DANAK-accredited EU ETS verifiers was found publicly available. DANAK confirms it accredits verification bodies under ISO 14065 and Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2018/2067 for EU ETS verification activities. Only two verifiers were confirmed through published sources; the complete list requires interactive access to DANAK's searchregister database or direct contact with DANAK.",

FINAS does not maintain a publicly searchable comprehensive list of accredited verifiers on their website. Only one accredited EU ETS/GHG verification body could be located: AFRY Finland Oy (VB05). The FINAS accredited operators directory and main verifiers pages describe accreditation frameworks and requirements but do not display individual organization listings. Official scope documents with Vxx/Mxx/yyyy numbering are available for individual accredited bodies but require direct access. FINAS can be contacted at akkreditointi@finas.fi or +358 29 5052 000 for complete current listings."

Norsk Akkreditering maintains an accredited organization registry at akkreditert.no with 98+ organizations. While the database includes an "ETS" accreditation scope category (Emissions Trading System), the actual list of accredited EU ETS or GHG verification bodies is not publicly available as a static document, PDF, or spreadsheet. Organizations appear to be listed in a dynamic, interactive database requiring direct access to the website's search tool. Individual organizations with ETS/GHG/ISO 14065/ISO 14064 verification scopes cannot be extracted without interactive database queries. At least one EU ETS verifier (Ecoxy) operates in Norway but could not be confirmed as officially accredited by Norsk Akkreditering via public documentation. To obtain the official list, direct contact with Norsk Akkreditering (post@akkreditert.no or +47 64 84 86 00) or interactive access to their searchable database is required.

9 unique accredited GHG verification bodies retrieved from ESYD official registry. ESYD (Ε.ΣΥ.Δ.) is Greece's national accreditation body under EU Regulation 765/2008. Verifiers are accredited under ISO 14065:2013 and EU Regulation 600/2012 for stationary installations, and under Implementing Regulation (EU) 2018/2067 for maritime shipping emissions (MRV). ESYD maintains detailed certification scope documents for each verifier (downloadable from registry page). Two accreditation scopes found: Section 1 covers stationary installations and aviation emissions; Section 2 covers maritime monitoring, reporting and verification (EU MRV Regulation 2015/757). Additional accreditation for ISO 14064-1 and ICAO CORSIA noted where applicable.

IPAC (Instituto Português de Acreditação) is Portugal's National Accreditation Body for EU ETS and GHG verification under ISO 14065 and ISO/IEC 17029:2021. Only one entity could be retrieved due to technical barriers: IPAC's main website (ipac.pt) is inaccessible via WebFetch (socket errors). The complete list exists but is distributed across individual Technical Annexes (Anexos Técnicos) hosted on various servers. Contact IPAC directly (+351 218 732 400, acredita@ipac.pt, Rua António Gião 2, 4º, 2829-513 Caparica) to obtain the full current registry of accredited verifiers. The single entity retrieved (Tecnoveritas) was found in IPAC Technical Annex H0005 dated 2025-02-14.

INAB (Irish National Accreditation Board) offers accreditation to EN ISO 14065:2023 for greenhouse gas verification bodies for EU ETS purposes. However, as of the current date, no organizations are listed as accredited by INAB under this scope. The official Directory of Greenhouse Gas Verifiers on the INAB website explicitly states "There are no verification bodies accredited by INAB." INAB previously had an arrangement with RvA (Dutch Accreditation Body) to provide accreditation on their behalf. Organizations wishing to work as verifiers in Ireland from other EU member states must be accredited to ISO 14065 by INAB or another EA member accreditation body.

Successfully fetched official BELAC accredited validation and verification bodies list from FPS Economy website. All 7 entities are BELAC-accredited for EU ETS verification and validation services under Commission implementing Regulation (EU) 2018/2067. Detailed scope documents available via links to http://ng3.economie.fgov.be/NI/belac/ghg/scope_pdf/ for each body. Data last updated 10 June 2026.

Extracted from Czech Accreditation Institute (ČIA) official database of accredited validation and verification organizations. All 6 entities are registered as GHG emissions verification/validation bodies for EU ETS compliance. Scopes include general verification body accreditation and GHG-specific verification certifications. All entities are firms (limited liability companies or joint-stock companies).

NAH (Nemzeti Akkreditáló Hatóság - National Accreditation Authority of Hungary) is the official body responsible for accrediting EU ETS verifiers/validators in Hungary under NAR-01-10 program and ISO 14065/Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2018/2067. The registry exists on the NAH website but uses dynamic/JavaScript-rendered content that cannot be extracted via standard web fetch methods. The verifiers database is maintained at https://www.nah.gov.hu/hu/kategoriak/az-uveghazhatasu-gazok-hitelesitese-eu-ets--eu-ets/ (Hungarian) or equivalent English pages. Direct access to the website, manual browsing of the searchable database, or contacting NAH directly (Phone: +36 (1) 550-1007, Email: titkarsag@nah.gov.hu, Address: 1119 Budapest, Tétényi út 82, Hungary) is required to obtain the current list of accredited entities. NAH is a member of the European cooperation for Accreditation (EA) with Full Member status.

The RENAR website (https://www.renar.ro/) maintains a searchable database of accredited conformity assessment bodies including greenhouse gas emissions verification bodies (Category 9), but the dynamic search interface prevents automated extraction of the complete list. Only SRAC was confirmed through direct web searches as a RENAR-accredited EU ETS verifier. CertRom and other certification bodies were mentioned as RENAR-accredited but primarily for management systems (ISO 9001, ISO 14001), not specifically for EU ETS/GHG verification. The official registry can be accessed at https://www.renar.ro/index.php/en/oec/search by filtering for Activity 9 or contacting RENAR directly at renar@renar.ro or +40 21 402 04 71."

TURKAK's official registry at turkak.org.tr could not be accessed directly due to SSL certificate verification failure. Entities listed were extracted from third-party sources (individual organization websites and the Embedded Carbon Record verification directory). TURKAK is the sole accreditation body for GHG verifiers in Turkey under law 4457. Verifiers must comply with TS EN ISO 14065 and TS EN ISO/IEC 17029 standards. The Embedded Carbon Record directory indicates 2 accredited firms in Turkey; this extraction found 4 verifiers with confirmed TURKAK accreditation for greenhouse gas verification or ISO 14064-related services. Note: TURKAK has expanded MLA coverage to include ISO 14065, ISO 14066, ISO 14064-3, and ISO 14064-1/2 standards as of recent updates."

Swiss Accreditation Service (SAS) maintains a searchable database of accredited bodies at https://www.seco.admin.ch/en/search-accredited-bodies-sas, but the interface is interactive and not directly crawlable. No public static directory or downloadable list of GHG/ETS verifiers is currently published. Status as of July 2026: The SAS is developing the framework for accreditation of validation and verification bodies (SVVS) in accordance with ISO/IEC 17029, but this accreditation type is not yet available and applications have not begun processing. Verification and validation body accreditation for GHG (per ISO 14065/ISO/IEC 17029) has not yet been operationalized by SAS. For access to accredited bodies, users must query the interactive search tool directly or contact SAS (info@sas.ch).

Official Austrian EU ETS verifiers list is maintained in the Union Registry (union-registry-data.ec.europa.eu) queryable database rather than as a static published list. Akkreditierung Austria maintains accredited bodies database but does not expose a direct downloadable roster of GHG/EU ETS verifiers. The Austrian Emissions Trading Registry at emissionshandelsregister.at/en/marketparticipants/verifiers directs users to query the Union Registry directly. Two confirmed accredited verifiers were identified (TÜV Austria Services GmbH, Quality Austria Certification), but a complete official registry extract was not accessible via public web fetch. To obtain the full list, users must: (1) Access union-registry-data.ec.europa.eu and filter by Austria/Verifier/Open status, or (2) Contact Akkreditierung Austria directly at akkreditierung@bmwet.gv.at or office@akkreditierung-austria.gv.at.

Partial list extracted from CNAS official website. The CNAS registry maintains a searchable database of accredited GHG validation and verification bodies. Web sources indicate China has nine total accredited GHG VVBs as of 2024, but the complete interactive directory (available at https://cims.cnas.org.cn/cims-cnas/certificationBody/toCbCatalogue.do) does not fully expose entity data through standard web fetching. Five entities with individual detail pages were successfully verified and extracted. Additional accredited bodies may exist in the complete registry but were not accessible through public web pages. Full details including accreditation numbers and complete scopes are contained in PDF certificates and scope documents referenced on each entity's detail page but not fully extracted in this fetch."

JAB (Japan Accreditation Board) maintains an official registry of ISO 14065/ISO 14064 accredited GHG validation and verification bodies at https://www.jab.or.jp/service/greenhouse_gas. However, the registry database is not directly accessible via programmatic fetch—the website uses JavaScript rendering that prevents content extraction. The registry is publicly accessible in a web browser and contains an interactive search/directory function. Only one entity (JQA) could be verified through independent sources and confirmed accreditation details. Other potential accredited bodies mentioned in searches (ClassNK, JICQA) could not be independently verified within the tool call budget. JAB's ISO 14065 accreditation program covers organizational (ISO 14064-1) and project-level (ISO 14064-2) GHG verification, plus ICAO CORSIA verification."

Direct access to the SCC registry (https://scc-ccn.ca/accreditation/find-accredited-body and https://scc-ccn.ca/accreditation/accreditation-programs/verification-and-validation) returned HTTP 403 Forbidden. The official accredited bodies list, PDFs, and SCC directory pages are not publicly accessible via WebFetch. The five entities listed above were extracted from publicly available web pages and news announcements. To obtain the official complete list, users must contact SCC directly or access their restricted directory at scc-ccn.ca. This extraction is partial and incomplete.

The EMA maintains an official registry of accredited GHG verification/validation organisms (OVV-GEI per ISO 14065/ISO 14064-3) accessible through an interactive search portal at https://ema.mx/saema/ConsultaPublica/Acreditados/Busqueda/OVVGEI. However, the complete list is not available as a static, downloadable file or publicly cached page. A referenced PDF export (consultaema.mx:75/OVVGEI/OVV_GEI_acreditados.pdf) is offline. Only one accredited verifier was located through public search results. To obtain the complete current list, users must access EMA's interactive consultation portal directly or contact EMA at (55) 9148 4300 / Mariano Escobedo No. 564, Mexico City."

ONAC maintains a publicly accessible directory of accredited OVV GEI (ISO 14065) bodies for greenhouse gas validation and verification in Colombia. All five discoverable accreditations have been voluntarily withdrawn as of early 2024. The ONAC directory is interactive and searchable at https://onac.org.co/directorio-de-acreditados/ but requires direct access to filter for active accreditations. No currently active OVV GEI accreditations were found in the publicly indexed and directly accessible records as of July 2026. The five entities listed represent all OVV GEI accreditation records discovered in the ONAC directory accessible via web fetching; there may be additional active or historical records accessible only through ONAC's interactive directory search tool.

13 accredited GHG verification bodies under NABCB ISO 14065:2020 and ISO/IEC 17029:2019 scope. All entities are firms operating in India. Data extracted from official NABCB validation-and-verification-bodies directory. Websites verified via WebSearch where available. BMNS Services has no public website identified.

Registry exists but inaccessible: register.jasanz.org shows "Loading..." (JavaScript-only SPA); jas-anz.org has self-signed cert; register.jas-anz.org has expired cert. Official accredited bodies registers for JAS-ANZ (Australia/NZ) GHG verification bodies (ISO 14065, ISO 14064 scope) cannot be fetched via standard web methods. Individual organization pages found in search results (e.g., Intertek SAI Global, Bureau Veritas Australia, SGS Australia) but could not be rendered. Requires browser interaction or direct API access.

Five ISO 14065-accredited GHG verification and validation bodies (VVBs) operating in South Africa under SANAS accreditation. All entities hold valid accreditation confirmed via SANAS national accreditation body. All are multinational firms with South Africa operations.

IAS maintains an interactive searchable database at https://www.iasonline.org/search-accredited-organizations-2/ for validation and verification bodies (VVBs), but does not publish a static, comprehensive downloadable directory. Only 2 VVBs were confirmable via direct certificate pages accessible through automated fetching. Both are Taiwan-based firms. The IAS Portal (portal.iasonline.org) requires interactive or authenticated access. No US-based IAS-accredited VVBs were found in publicly accessible pages. IAS accreditation is under ISO/IEC 17029 standard via their AC800 program. For complete current listings, users must access the interactive search tool or contact IAS directly at +1 562-364-8201 or www.iasonline.org.

TAF (Taiwan Accreditation Foundation) maintains the official directory of ISO 14065 & ISO/IEC 17029 accredited GHG verification bodies at https://www.taftw.org.tw/en/find-facility/scheme/cav/, but the list is loaded dynamically via AJAX and not accessible via static web fetch. The directory requires live browser interaction to display individual accredited organization names, addresses, and contact information. TAF is the official accreditation body under Taiwan's Climate Change Response Act and accredits validation/verification bodies for greenhouse gas emissions verification, carbon footprint verification, and ICAO CORSIA verification. Contact TAF directly at +886-2-2809-0828 (New Taipei City) or 03-5336333 (Hsinchu) for current accredited bodies list.

KAN (Komite Akreditasi Nasional / National Accreditation Committee) accredits greenhouse gas verification and validation bodies (LVV GRK) based on SNI ISO/IEC 17029 and ISO 14065 standards. The official KAN website (kan.or.id) maintains a directory of accredited bodies but experienced technical access issues during this research. Three bodies confirmed as accredited with details extracted from official announcements and company websites; one body in active accreditation process. Additional bodies (BSPJI Palembang, PT RPN) mentioned as seeking accreditation but insufficient detail to verify current status from fetched sources.

All 18 VVBs listed are accredited under Thailand's T-VER (Thailand Voluntary Emission Reduction) program managed by the Greenhouse Gas Management Organization (TGO). All entities are currently active. The list was obtained from the official TGO registry accessed on 2026-07-17. Verification and validation activities cover multiple GHG reduction sectors including energy, manufacturing, waste, agriculture, transport, and afforestation.

Official list sourced from ART TREES verification page (https://www.artredd.org/verification/), which links to the May 2026 PDF document. Contains 2 fully approved VVBs and 3 provisionally approved VVBs as of May 2026. Document states: 'Applications to be an ART approved Validation and Verification Body are currently being reviewed. This list will be updated as applications are processed.'

Washington State Department of Ecology maintains lists of accredited verifiers for the Climate Commitment Act cap-and-invest program but does not publish them online. Two publications exist but are inaccessible: Publication 23-14-011 (emissions verifiers, 404 error) and Publication 26-14-008 (offset verifiers, 403 Forbidden). To obtain the official list, contact: emissions verification (GHGReporting@ecy.wa.gov) or offset verification (CCAOffsets@ecy.wa.gov, 360-280-6488). Regulations: WAC 173-446-540 requires verification bodies to be accredited; WAC 173-441-085 specifies requirements for individual verifiers.

Quebec SPEDE (Système de plafonnement et d'échange de droits d'émission de gaz à effet de serre - cap-and-trade system) does not maintain a publicly available official registry of accredited verifiers on the Ministry of Environment website. SPEDE requires verifiers to be ISO 14065-accredited through the Standards Council of Canada (SCC-CCN) or equivalent international bodies under ISO 17011 and ISO 14064-3. The actual list of ISO 14065-accredited verifiers is maintained by SCC (scc-ccn.ca), not by Quebec government. Attempted fetch of SCC directory returned 403 Forbidden. For current accredited verifiers, contact SPEDE Registrar at registraireqc-spede@environnement.gouv.qc.ca or 418 521-3868, option 3 / 1 833-522-0935, option 3.

British Columbia does not maintain a publicly accessible, centralized registry of accredited GHG verification bodies for the OBPS (Output-Based Pricing System) or CleanBC programs. The BC government directs operators to consult the Standards Council of Canada (SCC) directory at https://scc-ccn.ca/search/accredited-organizations and the ANSI National Accreditation Board at https://anab.ansi.org/accreditation/greenhouse-gas-validation-verification/ instead. Verification bodies must be accredited through SCC or ANSI to ISO 14064-3 and ISO 14065 standards. No provincial list of designated operators or approved verifiers is published by BC. This approach differs from other major carbon programs (EU ETS, California) that maintain detailed public verifier registries.

The CSA Group GHG CleanProjects registry website (csaregistries.ca) does not publish a public directory of approved verifiers accessible via standard web scraping. Both entities confirmed here are independently accredited under ISO 14065 and explicitly provide validation/verification services to CSA Group's carbon registries. No comprehensive public list of all approved verifiers for CSA CleanProjects could be retrieved; only entities verified through direct association with CSA registry services appear above. ANAB and SCC accreditation directories require authentication and could not be accessed. The registry appears to operate as a project tracking platform where verifiers are listed within individual project records rather than in a centralized accredited-body directory."

The UK Woodland Carbon Code does not maintain a single comprehensive public directory of all accredited validation/verification bodies. The official website pages for validation (3-validation) and verification (4-verification) clearly list only Organic Farmers & Growers and Soil Association as currently accredited bodies with full contact information. References to SGS, SFQC, and Acoura appear in historical/news contexts but their current accreditation status could not be verified from official sources. The validation and verification body processes page confirms that all accredited bodies must be certified by the UK Accreditation Service to ISO 17029:2019, ISO 14065:2020, and ISO 14064-3:2019. No comprehensive current list was found on the registry website itself."

Three validation and verification bodies (VVBs) identified from the official IUCN UK Peatland Programme registry. Two are fully approved and accredited to ISO/IEC 17029:2019 and ISO/14065:2020. SAC Consulting is in pending status pending UKAS accreditation. All are firms operating in the UK. Contact for accreditation inquiries: Garance Wood-Moulin (GWMoulin@iucn.org.uk).

The Label Bas-Carbone program explicitly does not maintain a closed list of approved auditors or verification bodies. Project leaders select any competent and independent auditor meeting criteria in their specific methodology. Eligible verifiers include COFRAC-accredited organizations (ISO 14065), JI/CDM-accredited bodies, and recognized forestry/environmental certification organizations. No centralized public registry exists. Individual methodologies may contain auditor lists in their own documentation. COFRAC maintains an accreditation database at https://tools.cofrac.fr/en/easysearch but does not provide a public-filtered list for Label Bas-Carbone specifically. Sources: https://label-bas-carbone.ecologie.gouv.fr/reglementation, https://www.legifrance.gouv.fr/loda/id/JORFTEXT000052201236, https://www.cofrac.fr/en/our-fields-of-application/energy-efficiency-and-transition/verification-of-greenhouse-gas-emission-declarations"

Successfully retrieved official VVBs from Cercarbono (https://cercarbono.com/validation-and-verification/), which uses EcoRegistry as its blockchain-based registry platform for managing carbon credits in Colombia and Latin America. List includes 24 firms approved as Validation and Verification Bodies across two programs: Cercarbono Carbon Programme (20 VVBs) and Cercarbono Circular Economy Programme (4 VVBs). All entities listed have active GHG/emissions/carbon verification accreditations from recognized accreditation bodies (IAF, DOE, ONAC, etc.) and hold valid accreditation periods. Colombian-based VVBs identified: NOVA CERT LLC, Equipo Versa, and ICONTEC. Entities extracted exactly as published on official Cercarbono VVB directory page.

Successfully retrieved City Forest Credits approved Validation and Verification Bodies (VVBs) from official PDF document dated November 2022 (latest comprehensive version found). All 7 entities are approved verifiers for carbon projects under the City Forest Credits Program. One entity (Ecofor, LLC) is a firm; six are individual practitioners. All are US-based. The program focuses on tree preservation and tree planting project verification.

Retrieved 18 accredited Designated Operational Entities (DOEs) for UNFCCC Article 6.4 (PACM) from the official accreditation page. All entities are currently accredited as of July 2026. Entity type is 'firm' for all entries (no individual practitioners found on this registry). Sectoral scopes reference the GHG mitigation/verification categories each DOE is authorized to work in. Geographic distribution: India (7 entities), China (2), Brazil (2), South Korea (2), Germany, Luxembourg, Japan, and Jordan (1 each). All data extracted from official UNFCCC Article 6.4 mechanism pages and verified sources.

Extracted from REDcert's official approved certification bodies registry as of December 16, 2025. Total: 35 entities (34 approved/active, 1 terminated as of Dec 31, 2025). Geographic distribution: Germany (24), Poland (9), Denmark (1), Greece (1). All entities are firms/organizations (entityType=firm). Data includes contact emails from the official registry page.

Official list of 42 SURE-EU certification bodies (firms) extracted from the June 26, 2026 PDF document published on the SURE website. All entities are active and approved for biomass/bioenergy certification under the SURE-EU system. Geographic distribution: Austria (5), Czech Republic (1), Estonia (2), Germany (23), Latvia (2), Poland (7), Spain (2). Contact information (names, phone, email) available in source PDF. All bodies are environmental auditing firms (Umweltgutachter) or certification organizations authorized to conduct verification and validation under SURE-EU for renewable energy sustainability compliance.

2BSvs is a European Commission-recognized voluntary scheme for GHG verification and sustainability certification, primarily for biofuels, biogas, and biomass under RED II/RED III. All 8 listed bodies are accredited to conduct GHG audits for 2BSvs clients. All entities are firms (no individual practitioners found on the official registry). All website URLs and accreditation details extracted directly from https://www.2bsvs.org/certification-bodies/.

Official SBP accredited certification bodies obtained from https://sbp-cert.org/certifications/accredited-certification-bodies/. All five bodies are independent certification organizations meeting rigorous competence and integrity requirements. Geographic scope: worldwide (excluding Russia and Belarus). These organizations perform verification/validation audits for SBP compliance on biomass production and supply chains, which includes sustainability and emissions-related assessments within the renewable fuels/bioenergy sector.

UL Solutions operates as an ISO 14025 program operator for EPD verification but does not publicly publish a directory of approved third-party verifiers. Their service terms require LCAs to be verified by "an authorized third-party verifier" but no public list of such verifiers is maintained on ul.com. The company maintains a registry of approved EPD declarations (per ISO 14025 requirements) accessible via the restricted SPOT database, but verifier identities are not disclosed publicly. Unlike programs such as the International EPD System or HPD Collaborative, UL Solutions appears to conduct internal verification reviews rather than maintaining a public accreditation body directory.

IBU EPD program lists 27 approved independent verifiers across 6 countries (Germany, Switzerland, UK, France, Austria, Italy). These are individual practitioners appointed by the IBU Advisory Board (Sachverständigenrat). No individual contact information, websites, or email addresses are publicly available on the IBU website. All verifiers are classified as individual-practice per EPD program conventions. The list represents verifiers for EPD verification/validation in the building and construction materials sector. Source: https://ibu-epd.com/en/ibu/verifiers/ fetched July 2026.

Official registry of Norwegian independent verifiers approved by EPD-Norge. List includes 31 verifiers (29 firms, 2 individual practitioners) qualified to verify Environmental Product Declarations under the EPD-Norge program. EPD verification encompasses LCA and GHG/carbon assessment aligned with ISO 14025 standards. The original epd-norge.no domain redirects to epd-global.com, which is the current official host. Source page maintains alphabetical listing with contact details and organization affiliations.

Official registry page at https://epd-australasia.com/about-us/individual-verifiers/ exists but is not accessible via automated web retrieval (socket connection errors). Website states 18 approved individual verifiers and 2 accredited process certifiers total as of July 2026, but complete list could not be retrieved. Partial list extracted from web search results and EPD Australasia blog posts. Five individual verifiers and one accredited certifier confirmed through secondary sources; 13+ additional verifiers remain unconfirmed. Registry is maintained by EPD Australasia, the Swedish Environmental Management Council (SMC)-accredited program operator for Environmental Product Declarations in the Australasia region.

SmartEPD Independent Verifiers list retrieved from official registry. Total: 53 entities (35 individual practitioners + 18 consulting firms). All entities appear on the official SmartEPD resources page under the Independent Verifiers section. Verifiers span multiple countries (primarily US and Canada, plus Estonia, Norway, South Korea, Argentina). Some individuals listed are associated with consulting firms and have those firms listed as website contacts.

NSF International does not maintain a public directory of approved verifiers or accredited certification bodies for its EPD program. NSF functions as an EPD program operator and verifier itself, assigning internal and independent reviewers on a per-project basis. Unlike other EPD programs (e.g., EPD International/Environdec, EPD Australasia), NSF does not accredit or publish a list of external verifiers. Searches conducted: WebFetch to nsf.org and info.nsf.org EPD pages (returned 403), multiple targeted searches for "NSF EPD verifiers," "approved verifiers," and "certification bodies." No public verifier directory exists. This finding is definitive across attempted access methods (budget: 8 tool calls used).

ASTM EPD program does not maintain a public directory of accredited verifiers. ASTM website pages (https://www.astm.org/products-services/certification/environmental-product-declarations.html) return HTTP 403 Forbidden, preventing direct verification. ASTM manages verifiers through internal contracts and refers inquiries to cert@astm.org. Only one verifier (Thomas Gloria) could be confirmed via published EPD documents and web sources. Unlike some other EPD programs, ASTM does not publish an approved verifiers list.

BRE EPD / EN 15804 programme does not maintain a publicly accessible directory of approved verifiers or accredited bodies. Verifiers are appointed by BRE internally and are not listed on their website (bregroup.com), GreenBook Live, or any official public registry. Contact BRE directly at Envprofiles15804@bregroup.com for current verifier information. Related International EPD System (IEPDS) maintains a multi-page approved verifiers list (environdec.com/services/individual-verifiers) with limited UK-specific data accessible; one UK verifier identified (Charnett Chau, Freelance) but full pagination/extraction not possible via WebFetch. Programme documents (Scheme Document SD207-Rev-6.0, LP1013 General Programme Instructions) exist but contain no published verifier list or contact details.

Three entities found: One registered EPD Verification Body (Kaken Test Center) and two System Certification Bodies (JQA and SuMPO). The SuMPO EPD registry pages for registered verifiers and system certification bodies are the official sources. Individual verifiers (個人検証員) are noted as "currently under preparation" and not yet published. English translations of these pages are still in progress. The Kaken Test Center is the only currently active registered verification organization for conducting EPD verifications under the SuMPO EPD program.

Data extracted from ICR official blog posts and documentation. The ICR directory indicates 15-19 total approved VVBs. All 7 entities listed here are confirmed approved VVBs with verified accreditation under ISO 14065 or equivalent standards by International Accreditation Forum (IAF) members. Additional VVBs exist but are not accessible via direct web fetching as the directory requires account login or JavaScript rendering. Each VVB listed has signed an agreement with ICR and maintains accreditation for GHG validation and verification services across multiple sectors including renewable energy, waste management, afforestation, and agriculture.

Carbon Standards International (carbon-standards.com) maintains an approval process for Validation and Verification Bodies (VVBs) and Certification Bodies (CBs) for carbon/GHG verification and certification. However, no publicly accessible registry of currently approved bodies could be located on their website or through any fetched public documents. The organization states that approved bodies are "published on the website of CSI" but this list is not available through their public-facing pages, documents section, or downloadable formats. The original domain carbonstandards.com (without hyphen) is for sale; the active organization is at carbon-standards.com (with hyphen). Direct contact with CSI at info@carbon-standards.com or +41 62 552 10 90 would be required to obtain the official list.

Ecosystem Restoration Standard (ERS) approved VVBs. The official ERS website redirects to Equitable Earth (eq-earth.com). Fetched official directory at /vvb listing 5 active approved verification and validation bodies and 4 pending approval. All active bodies are ISO 14065:2020 accredited for GHG verification work.

Extensive search conducted (12 tool calls) across Riverse.io, Rainbow Standard documentation (rainbowstandard.io, registry.rainbowstandard.io, docs.rainbowstandard.io), and web searches. No public directory of approved VVBs found. Riverse (rebranded to Rainbow Standard as of 2025) maintains VVB accreditation requirements and procedures documentation, but does not publish a freely accessible roster of accredited verification bodies. Individual VVB identities appear only in project-specific verification reports on the registry. Contact with Riverse/Rainbow Secretariat directly may be required to obtain the complete approved VVBs list.

Four Certification Bodies accredited for EPD verification. All maintain accreditations from Accreditation Bodies with International Mutual Recognition agreements (EA, IAF). Retrieved from official EPDItaly verification page.

EPD Hub does not publish a formal accreditation directory of firms/organizations. Instead, it maintains a verification committee of individual LCA/EPD professionals. The 23 verifiers listed above represent all individuals identified on the official verification committee page. EPD Hub assigns verifiers to projects directly (companies cannot choose). For a comprehensive current list or additional accredited bodies, contact EPD Hub at hub@epdhub.com. Note: EPD Hub is separate from EPD International (environdec.com), which maintains its own verifier directories.

Partial list retrieved from official PEP ecopassport registry. Primary source AP-0006 (Accredited Verifiers List) accessed but full extraction limited. The document indicates approximately 35 total accredited verifiers exist. Individual verifiers listed are extracted from the fetched PDF and verified CODDE page. Major accreditation bodies (Bureau Veritas, SGS, TÜV) confirmed from supplementary sources. Full verifiers list requires direct document access or contact with contact@pep-ecopassport.org. Verifiers undergo ISO 14025 accreditation and 3-year renewal cycle.

Primary Korea EPD registry at greenproduct.go.kr (operated by KEITI/Ministry of Environment) was not accessible during this search. IGSC Inc is the only Korean accredited certification body confirmed on the EPD International accredited bodies list as of the search date. KEITI (Korea Environmental Industry & Technology Institute) manages the Korea EPD program and has established mutual recognition agreements with EPD-Norway and EPD International. The greenproduct.go.kr portal is noted as the official registry but could not be accessed to retrieve the complete authoritative list. Individual verifiers specific to Korea were not found on the EPD International individual verifiers list - all Korean verification may operate through the accredited certification body (IGSC Inc)."

Partial list identified through web research. The complete official registry of ~40 designated K-ETS verification bodies is maintained by the National Institute of Environmental Research (NIER) on Korea's Public Data Portal at https://www.data.go.kr/data/15082976/fileData.do (most recent: 20250106 version). The authoritative list includes organization names, designation numbers, designation dates, validity periods, locations, and specialized fields. Full list file exists as XLSX/HWPX downloadable files but content was not accessible. Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment updates this list regularly. Only 5 major verifiers could be identified from web pages; previous attempts found 8, indicating significant additional verifiers exist in official registry but were not captured in this extraction due to file access restrictions. Recommend direct access to NIER designation office (NIER GHG Verification Organization Designation Office) or public data portal file download for complete list.</notes>
</invoke>

Extracted 65 entities total: 23 currently active accredited DOEs, 1 marked as inactive, and 41 withdrawn DOEs. Previous sweep captured 64; additional inactive status entry included here. All entities are GHG/CDM verification bodies (validation/verification scopes 1-16 cover all CDM sectoral scopes). Data sourced from official UNFCCC CDM DOE list page as of July 2026. Note: Some active accredited DOEs (E-0001, E-0034, E-0044) have been inactive but not formally withdrawn. CDM DOE accreditation ceases 31 December 2026.

DEHSt does not publish a static or downloadable list of EU ETS verification bodies. The DEHSt website refers users to the DAkkS (German Accreditation Body) which maintains the official searchable database of accredited verifiers at https://www.dakks.de/en/accredited-bodies-search.html. Verification bodies must be accredited under DIN EN ISO 14065 and DIN EN ISO 14064-3. The DAkkS database requires interactive searching by scope, location, and certification status, and is not available as a downloadable PDF or structured data format that could be extracted. Individual verifiers appear in a searchable online interface maintained by DAkkS, not on a static DEHSt-published list.

Registry confirmed to exist at https://directorio.inn.cl/ for accredited GHG validation/verification organisms under NCh-ISO 14065:2021 (program: "Organismos de validación y verificación - Huella de carbono/GEI"). The directory is an interactive database requiring user-filtered search; actual entity listings cannot be retrieved via automated fetch. INN accreditation service page at https://www.inn.cl/servicio-acreditacion/organismos-de-validacion-y-verificacion/ confirms the scheme exists but does not list individual organizations. Application/inquiry: https://sdac.inn.cl/

OAA Argentina maintains an official registry of GHG verification/validation bodies (organismos validadores/verificadores de gases de efecto invernadero) accredited under ISO 14065 + IAF MD 6 + ISO 14064-3. The searchable registry is located at https://oaa.org.ar/publico/entidades-acreditadas/busqueda and https://oaa.org.ar/publico/reconocimiento/entidades-reconocidas. However, the actual list of accredited entities cannot be retrieved via WebFetch due to the interactive nature of the search portal. A Google Sheets spreadsheet of recognized entities is referenced but link details not directly accessible. Contact OAA at www.oaa.org.ar for the current complete list of accredited OVV (Organismos de Validación/Verificación de GEI).

Retrieved from official INACAL Directory of Accredited Management Systems Certification Bodies (OCSG) dated July 3, 2026. These 11 OCSG-accredited organizations are authorized to perform certification activities under INACAL accreditation. INACAL has established a specific accreditation scheme for ISO 14065 (greenhouse gas validation and verification), but the public directory document does not explicitly detail which organizations hold the ISO 14065 specific scope. Individual scope documents would need to be consulted to confirm current ISO 14065 accreditation for each entity. Source document is available in Spanish; all translations are direct.

Official Inmetro registry URLs returned socket closed errors during fetching attempts. The CGCRE accreditation program for OVV (Organismos de Verificação de Inventários de Gases de Efeito Estufa) under ISO 14065 was confirmed to exist with last update on 2025-02-07. The actual database query interface at inmetro.gov.br/organismos/consulta.asp could not be accessed. To retrieve the current list of accredited verifiers, direct contact with Inmetro or access to their online query portal is required. Known organizations providing these services in Brazil include Ecogest, SGS, TÜV SÜD, and Bureau Veritas, though specific accreditation status was not verified.

EGAC maintains accreditation registries for Validation and Verification Bodies under ISO/IEC 14065 and ISO/IEC 17029, but the complete official public list is not accessible via standard web search or public pages. The registry appears to be housed in a closed database system at system.egac.gov.eg requiring direct authentication. Only two entities (COAE and SGS) were identified and verified from actual fetched sources. For a comprehensive list of all EGAC-accredited GHG verification bodies, direct contact with EGAC is required: info@egac.gov.eg, Phone: 202-25275224/5/7. EGAC scope confirms validation/verification services for greenhouse gas emissions, environmental labeling, and product declarations in accordance with ISO/IEC 17029:2019 and ISO/IEC 14065:2020."

GAC (GCC Accreditation Center, Saudi Arabia) does not maintain a published registry of ISO 14065 GHG verification body accreditations. While GAC offers accreditation for Validation and Verification Bodies under ISO/IEC 17029, no specific ISO 14065 GHG verification program or public list of accredited GHG verifiers was found on the official website. The accredited bodies directory at gac.org.sa/accredited-bodies/ does not provide filterable results for GHG verification. Contact GAC directly for inquiries about ISO 14065 GHG verification body accreditation status.

Fetched from two official sources: (1) EIAC official directory confirmed Carbon Assurance FZ LLC as the first EIAC-accredited VVB in UAE (Certificate No. 1, August 2025). (2) Global CBAM Verifier Directory lists 5 additional ISO 14065 accredited firms operating in UAE with valid accreditation from national accreditation bodies. Direct MOIAT/ENAS conformity assessment bodies database was not fully accessible but EIAC and Global CBAM registries provide verified proof of these entities. All 6 entities have active accreditation status for GHG/carbon verification under ISO 14065 standards or equivalent VVB frameworks.

Registry contains 4 HKCAS-accredited GHG verification bodies (as of July 3, 2026). All entities are currently active and provide greenhouse gas verification services under ISO 14064-1:2018 or equivalent standards. Data extracted from official HKAS Directory of Accredited Organisations PDF (updated weekly). All registrations verified for GHG/greenhouse gas verification scope in their accreditation certificate.

Data collected from two regulatory sources: (1) SAC (Singapore Accreditation Council) CAB Status Update showing 2025 accreditations, and (2) NEA (National Environment Agency) Carbon Pricing Act external auditors list from June 2020. The NEA list may be outdated; more recent accreditations likely exist but are accessible only via the interactive SACiNet database at https://sacinet2.enterprisesg.gov.sg/sacsearch/search. SAC accreditations cover ISO 14065, ISO 14064-3, and ISO 14067 standards. NEA auditors are accredited under the Carbon Pricing Act for GHG verification across specified industrial sectors. Three additional entities (CCIC Singapore) were referenced in search results but not confirmed on fetched source documents.

Standards Malaysia maintains an official Accreditation of Validation and/or Verification Bodies (AVVB) Scheme based on ISO 14065:2020 and ISO/IEC 17029:2019 standards. The registry is publicly accessible at cab.jsm.gov.my/cab-directories/srchAvvb. Direct contact with JSM is recommended for a complete current list: central@jsm.gov.my or +603-8008 2900.
